purpose: Teach: 会計士/生み出さ/染色/カスタム/補修/公約/不透明/枚数

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の会計士、ベテランで、信頼できる人材だ。
lines.en: Our accountant is a veteran — someone you can trust.
lines.style: Measured, declarative. Slight weight on 'veteran' — respect for experience. Clean opening, no softness. The tone of someone setting a fact down.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業、若手から、生み出された企画、形にしております。
lines.en: Yes. We're developing a plan that came from the younger staff, and shaping it into something real.
lines.style: Steady, professional clarity. Measured pace. Slight lift on 'developing' — pride in progress. Direct eye contact, no rush. The competent report.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 伝統工芸、染色技術、若手にも、継承させろ。
lines.en: Traditional craftsmanship, dyeing techniques — make sure the younger generation inherits them.
lines.style: Command delivered quietly. Weight on 'inherits' — this matters. Not harsh, but final. The voice of someone who sees the line between present and future.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様向け、カスタム製品の受注、増えております。
lines.en: Yes. We're seeing more custom product orders coming in from clients.
lines.style: Factual update, slight warmth underneath. Even pace. Subtle emphasis on 'more' — this is good news, but stated plainly. No overselling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 本社の補修工事、来月から、始まる予定だな。
lines.en: The headquarters renovation is scheduled to begin next month.
lines.style: Brief, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight downbeat on 'renovation' — this is happening. No elaboration needed. The tone of someone moving through agenda items with purpose.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経営陣の公約、社員にも、浸透しています。
lines.en: Yes. The management's commitments are taking root with the staff.
lines.style: Affirming tone. Gentle pride — this is working. Steady pace, warm without being effusive. The satisfaction of seeing intention become action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の先行き、不透明な部分もあるが、攻めていけ。
lines.en: The industry outlook has some unclear areas, but we need to stay aggressive.
lines.style: Honest acknowledgment of risk, then pivot to resolve. Slight pause before 'aggressive' — choosing the word deliberately. Measured but confident. The voice of leadership accepting uncertainty while pushing forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。配布資料の枚数、過剰にならないよう、調整します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure the distribution materials stay efficient — not excessive.
lines.style: Closing note, practical and precise. Slight nod on 'efficient' — detail matters. Quick, professional. The final reassurance of someone wrapping up loose ends.
